footnote: The same lines for every reader. CLANNAD: {CL_LINES} dialogue lines of a PS Vita playthrough, references read by Claude. vita-test, psp-test: {VT_LINES} and {PT_LINES} hand-checked lines of {VT_GAMES} and {PT_GAMES} games (VNDB screenshots). Dance with Devils: {DD_LINES} lines of the hooked test game VOCR6 held out, its own text as reference. VOCR read each crop alone and greedy, with no language model; the other engines use their own decoders. On vita-test and psp-test VOCR read the crops in the console's polarity and the others in screen colours; on CLANNAD and Dance with Devils every reader read the same grey crops.

* Lens also reads the furigana the references omit: {PT_FUR_ERR} of its {PT_ALL_ERR} psp-test and {VT_FUR_ERR} of its {VT_ALL_ERR} vita-test errors (names included) fall on the {PT_FUR_LINES} and {VT_FUR_LINES} lines with furigana. Private game data never goes to Lens, so it did not read Dance with Devils.

Seen: two of VOCR6's training games draw dialogue in CLANNAD's glyph raster and two share a release with it, so CLANNAD is not an unseen game for VOCR6. MeikiOCR's and PP-OCRv6 small's readings were the first candidates of CLANNAD's references (Lens's among the later rounds'); PP-OCRv6 small's and manga-ocr's were among those of vita-test and psp-test. Time: estimated for a 3-line box on one Cortex-A9 core at 444 / 333 MHz; VOCR6 has not run on a console yet.
